clientCard.name: 罗汉
clientCard.visual: blue-gray stone/crystal golem with thick forearms

implemented.target: Lock current visible enemy within range; no retarget or refund if target dies, hides, changes side or moves out of range.
implemented.duringWindup: No moving or ordinary attacks; ordinary cooldown still elapses. Stun, silence, charm and death interrupt. Cooldown and energy remain spent.
implemented.feedback: Cyan charge and pulse; target-loss feedback and recorded interruptions in battle analysis. Counters refer only to recorded effects, not an inferred total of every failed cast.

localAdaptations: This combines a mixed-date early skill card with the July attribute table, field by field. It does not establish a single original-client build.
Deterministic attack 160 is the rounded mean of printed 153–166, not a recovered random-damage implementation. Star doubling remains the local engine rule.
The card labels skill damage without proving magic/physical/true categories. Magic, generic resistance and ordinary-only landwalker true damage are local interpretations.
One-second startup, initial energy 0, Manhattan targeting/range, locked target, invalidation at release, no refund, frozen skill power and generic energy recovery are explicit local choices.
Fractional ordinary cooldown preserves the 2.2-second average on a 0.25-second tick. Animation recovery and exact action eligibility are not a measured original-client reconstruction.
Cooldown starts at charge start. Spells are checked on normal action slots, so practical starts can be later than exactly ten seconds apart.
The June random-target change remains documented as a later revision; it does not prove early targeting or a numerical startup duration.

compatibility.legacyVersion: aurora and earlier retain 750 HP, 60 attack, 3 armor, range 4, 1-second ordinary interval, old attack-based true-damage windup and old portrait.
compatibility.policy: Only prepare migrates to qi. In-flight battles, result, finished, history and playback retain their version until the next preparation. Resources, units, items, pool, shop, bans and seeds are preserved.

remaining: Other units still need same-era ability/fee/base-stat review and a coherent historical ruleset.
Natural three-star Arhat, high tier builds, economy and standard/challenge difficulty are not validated by these two seeds.
Final multi-build human play and actual weak-device/mobile touch measurements remain outstanding.
